races.title: State Senate, District 16
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Fentrice Driskell
cands.bio: Democratic state representative and House Democratic Leader (since 2022). Harvard B.A., Georgetown J.D.; former federal court clerk and Carlton Fields attorney. Elected to the House in 2018 (HD 63, then HD 67). Won the Aug 2026 Democratic primary for SD 16 and had no general-election opponent.
cands.local_ties: Born in Winter Haven, FL (1979); House districts in Hillsborough County; filed from Hillsborough County (FL DOE).

record.text: Won the Aug 2026 SD 16 Democratic primary 59.66% to 40.34% over Rep. Michele Rayner; general election unopposed.
Sponsored HB 49 (2023) creating a Historic Cemeteries Program focused on African American sites; April 2022 attempted sit-in during the congressional map vote.

endorsements.text: Primary endorsers per Wikipedia (citing Florida Politics): Alex Sink, Bob Buckhorn, Rick Kriseman, Andrew Warren, Rep. Jim Davis, Florida AFL-CIO, Sierra Club Florida, IBEW Locals 824 and 915, Teamsters Local 79.

cands.gaps: No donor reporting found. Unopposed, so no contested general. Owner-source search not run (search budget exhausted).

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).

money.note: Includes primary and general. 'State of Florida' lines are public matching funds; party-committee lines are mostly in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Florida Division of Elections, pulled Nov 3, 2026
